name: io.github.smarterweather/weather
title: Smarter Weather
description: Probabilistic weather forecasts, active alerts, and multi-model comparison from Smarter Weather.

environmentVariables.name: SMARTERWEATHER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Smarter Weather API key (sw_live_* or sw_test_*) with the 'mcp' scope. When set, the bridge skips the OAuth flow and forwards the key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on every proxied request. When unset, the bridge runs the full MCP OAuth 2.1 + PKCE client and caches tokens at ~/.mcp-auth/. Mint keys at https://smarterweather.com/developers/api-keys.

environmentVariables.name: SMARTERWEATHER_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the target MCP endpoint. Useful for development, staging, or pre-Track-F-MVP setups where the production hostname is not yet live. Precedence: positional argument > SMARTERWEATHER_MCP_URL > package default (https://mcp.smarterweather.com/mcp).
